notes.title: Demo Update: Chainshots and Assaults!
notes.notes:
[p]Ahoy there![/p][p]After recovering from the[b] Steam Next Fest[/b] hangover, we’ve polished our demo with the help of all the brave players who gave it a try – and we’ve added some exciting new content![/p][p]You now have access to [b]Chainshots[/b], a powerful type of cannonball designed to wreck enemy cannons and stations with precision and style.[/p][p][/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="169,343,"][tr][td colwidth="169"][p][/p][/td][td colwidth="343"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/368a8134a88c8a4ec146d3b7429495d2e5b5c470.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]These deadly rounds can be fired from the newly introduced cannon: [b]the Thunderer[/b]! You can get your hands on it at the Emporium, or as a reward in certain (rare) events.[/p][p][/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="202,284,"][tr][td colwidth="202"][p][/p][/td][td colwidth="284"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/e4893eb860b39b7315fe687c4166793a540cdf86.gif"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]And last but not least, we’ve added a brand-new battle event type: [b]Assaults[/b]. In these encounters, enemies have boarded your ship – and the only path to victory is a fierce [b]close-quarters fight[/b]! [/p][p]You’ll find [b]Rum[/b] especially handy during these skirmishes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/f2019bab264a93cc8e28dff2bd0d12c93a0b2be5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So, set sail for the demo, test out the new content, and don’t forget to share your thoughts with us.[/p][p]Fair winds![/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Assaults are now available as a type of combat event[/p][/*][*][p]Chainshot tactic card and Thunderer cannon available as rewards or to be purchased at the Emporium.[/p][/*][*][p]Rendering graphics pipeline simplified to address potential crashing problems and improve overall performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some in-combat situations where the game could end on a "softlock"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem where selecting certain resolution options was not scaling the window correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect interactions with fire sources[/p][/*][*][p]Added some QoL changes[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.notes:
[list]

notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a [b]major update to our demo![/b]
You can now select “New Game,” choose from available captains and ships, and play through the first sector, set in the Blue Sea.

[b]The Prologue has also been improved[/b], making it more accessible and better at explaining new mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259015/7771e1287571f0f5f7fb1c827ff2f0a4f95fcb33.png[/img]

We can’t wait for you to embark on your first adventure in [b]Red Rogue Sea[/b]! Be sure to let us know about your early journeys.

Fair winds!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.7
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added in-battle tooltips while holding “Alt” and hovering over a crew member, artillery piece, or station.

notes.title: Red Rogue Sea looks like a deck-building pirating version of FTL: Faster Than Light
notes.notes:
I adored FTL: Faster Than Light and Red Rogue Sea looks like a sweet evolution of the gameplay with pirates and deck-building.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/10/red-rogue-sea-looks-like-a-deck-building-pirating-version-of-ftl-faster-than-light
